summary: Derive snapshot-consistent continuous idle eligibility without using mail activity

replay.detail: The reader derives policy, refusal, eligibility epoch and deadline from existing accepted evidence; it writes no authoritative claims or suspensions.

schema.detail: Adds only a rebuildable claimant access index for retained seat-owned work, including carried or operator-authored ownership. No authoritative storage schema or checkpoint transition.

rules.detail: This adds an inert reader. Only OMP native proof can be eligible; unknown observations, missing channel proof, native session refusal, claimed work and running subagents block it.

compatibility.detail: Existing native diagnostic claim fields carry channel-ready or channel-unready evidence. No new claim field or automatic writer is enabled by the reader.

downtime.detail: No restart, migration or operator action is needed to read existing evidence.

manual.detail: No default or behavior change. Runtime deadline and agent-card integration is a separate dependent change.

recovery.detail: Reopening rebuilds the same continuous interval from authoritative claims; repeated quiet reports and silent mail do not reset it.
